Tables in this document are generated directly from the CSV/TSV sources in `data/`.

## Harmonized Table Column Reference

```{r}
metadata <- read.csv("../data/crops_all_years_metadata.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
knitr::kable(metadata, align = "rlll")
```

## LandIQ Classification Codes

```{r}
landiq_codes <- read.delim("../data/landiq_crop_mapping_codes.tsv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
knitr::kable(landiq_codes)
```

## Plant Functional Type (PFT) Mapping

```{r}
pft_table <- read.csv("../data/CARB_PFTs_table.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
knitr::kable(pft_table)
```
